column1: # The field menu's apps from the first save (launch_field_menus_w2_us.pbwinput): the oracle's labelled screens of the
# route, pbw-oracle's hashes of the pinned melonDS's output on the player's dump (SHA-1 of each screen's RGB bytes,
# frames.tsv's top and bottom; hashes only). where: app, a screen of an app the port must show at the row's count
# through Frigate's test launcher (oracle.py launch field_menus); field, a screen of the field or its menu, which the
# port can't show while overlay 36 has no C, held to the oracle's run only. count is GFL's frame count at oracle_frame,
# the first frame with that count.
